# Plans inside git: stores, ignores, workflow, branches and the change summary at check.
$ git init -q -b main
$ git config user.email test@example.com
$ git config user.name Test
$ git config commit.gpgsign false
write README.md hello\n
write TODO.md - one\n
write src/app.js // TODO: tidy\n// FIXME later\n
write CLAUDE.md # House rules\nUse tabs.\n
$ git add .
$ git commit -q -m init
$ wk init --store local
$ wk init --store local
$ wk brief
$ wk setup
$ wk add "Fix the login bug"
$ wk add "Speed up search"
$ wk start 4yrm
$ wk check
$ wk config set git.branch task
$ wk config set git.commit check
$ wk config set commit_style "short, imperative"
$ wk done 4yrm --force
$ wk start aes8
write src/search.js fast()\n
write src/app.js changed\n
$ wk check --test "Search feels instant"
$ wk done aes8
$ wk add "Write docs"
$ wk start yebg --no-branch
$ wk wait yebg "review"
$ wk config set git.branch project
$ wk project new "Search revamp"
$ wk add "Index titles" --in xcma
$ wk start m7sw
$ wk brief --json
$ wk board --out board.html
$ wk setup --done
write AGENTS.md # Agents\nBe brief.\n
$ wk brief
tree
